# nuclock_project (Resource)

A project: the unit work, hours and invoices belong to.

Destroying one **archives** it — it takes no new work, and its hours, invoices and payouts stay. Declaring an archived project again brings it back. Money — the agency fee and the default sale price — is not managed here; it stays in the tracker.

The key needs the `projects.write` ability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nuclock_project" "apollo" {
  title       = "Apollo"
  description = "The client portal rebuild"
  key_prefix  = "APO"
  currency    = "USD"
  manager_ids = [nuclock_user.lead.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `currency` (String) What the project is billed in, e.g. `USD`. The organisation's default when left out.
- `description` (String)
- `key_prefix` (String) What every task key here leads with (`NUC` in `NUC-142`). Guessed from the title when left out. The project's identity: `import { identity = { key_prefix = "NUC" } }`.
- `manager_ids` (Set of String) The people who run it (users holding the manager role).
- `owner_ids` (Set of String) The clients it belongs to — their accounts are the product's, made when they are given a project; look them up with the `nuclock_user` data source. Left out, the owners are not managed here.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
